official_article.title: A lab-based test of the gravitational redshift with a miniature clock network
method_semantics: Five clock ensembles produce ten simultaneous pairwise comparisons.
For the second analysis, each pair was re-analyzed individually over the same 14-run raw data with pair-specific corrections and a weighted mean.

Figure 4 maps each measured pairwise gravitational redshift to an inferred height difference using Delta h=(delta f/f)c^2/g while explicitly assuming general relativity and one independently measured local g.

Pairs share clocks and measurement runs; the paper accounts for shared-clock covariance in the per-run gradient error estimation, but the deposited process data contain no ten-edge pair covariance matrix for this new closure diagnostic.

files.name: Fig4.csv
files.content: ten pairwise inferred height differences and ten marginal 1-sigma uncertainties in cm
